name: blog-write
description: Write new blog articles from scratch optimized for Google rankings and AI citations. Generates full articles with template selection, answer-first formatting, Key Takeaways summary box, information gain markers, evidence-backed explanations, sourced statistics, Pixabay/Unsplash images, built-in SVG chart generation, optional FAQ sections, internal linking zones, and proper heading hierarchy. Supports MDX, markdown, and HTML output. Use when user says "write blog", "new blog post", "create article", "write about", "draft blog", "generate blog post".
